text: Which helix-turn-helix transcription factors are expressed in every brain region and have the nucleoplasm as their main location?
plan: Protein class: Transcription factors / Helix-turn-helix domains AND Brain region category (RNA): any / Detected in all AND Subcellular location (ICC): Nucleoplasm / Main location
understanding: Find helix-turn-helix transcription factors that are expressed across all human brain regions and have their main subcellular location annotated as the nucleoplasm.

trail.why: The requirement specifies helix-turn-helix transcription factors, which corresponds to the class 'Transcription factors' and subclass 'Helix-turn-helix domains'.
The category 'Detected in all' is defined as detected in every tissue, region, or cell type in the dataset, which satisfies being expressed in every brain region without restricting Level 1.
The requirement specifies the nucleoplasm as the main subcellular location, matching Level 1 'Nucleoplasm' and Level 2 'Main location'.

requirements.why: This field classifies genes by functional class such as transcription factors and their subclasses.
This field captures RNA specificity and distribution across human brain regions, allowing selection of genes expressed across all brain regions.
This field filters by immunofluorescence subcellular compartment, specifically supporting searches by 'Main location' and 'Nucleoplasm'.
